utme_subjects: and two other Arts subjects or Social Science subjects
olevel_requirement: Five (5) SSC credit passes to include English Language and Fine Arts.
direct_entry: (i) Two (2) 'A' Level passes in Arts or Fine Arts and any other subject. (ii) ND upper credit / HND lower credit from recognised institutions. For holders of NTC, the relevant subjects could be General Wood work, Building/Engineering Drawing, Introduction to Building Construction; Decorative Painting; Spray Painting, Lining, Sign and Design; Wall hanging, Colour Mixing/Matching and Glazing; Printing Origination; Machine Printing and Finishing; General Metal Work, Basic Electricity, Spinning, Weaving, Surface Design and Printing; Bleaching, Dyeing and Finishing; Graphic Design; Graphic Printing and Ceramics.

institution_waivers.note: DE: requires 'A' Level passes in Fine Arts and any other subjects, which must include Literature in English; accepts ND upper credit or HND lower credit in Fine Arts subjects from recognised institutions. O'Level: accepts five (5) 'O' Level credit passes to include English Language and one Arts subject; also accepts candidates without Fine Arts at 'O' Level. UTME subjects: accepts two (2) Arts subjects and any other subject.

DE: requires very good passes in three JUPEB/A' Level subjects — Theatre Arts: Literature in English and any two of Igbo/Yoruba, CRS/IRS, French, History, Government, Music and Visual Arts; Visual Arts: Visual Arts and any two of Igbo/Yoruba, CRS/IRS, French, History, Government and Music; Music: Music and any two from Literature in English, Igbo/Yoruba, CRS/IRS, French, History, Government, Economics, Chemistry, Biology, Further Mathematics and Visual Arts. Also accepts HND/OND at Upper Credit Level in Drama/Theatre and Music; NCE Music and Diploma or Advanced level in Music from the Royal School of Music London, Trinity College London and Musical Society of Nigeria (MUSON). O'Level: (a) Theatre Arts — Five O/Level credit passes in English Language, Literature-in-English, Mathematics and any other two subjects one of which must be an Arts subject; (b) Music — Five O/Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, two Arts subjects (may include Music) and any other subject; (c) Visual Arts — Five O/Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, two Arts subjects (may include any one of Fine Arts/Visual Arts/Photography/Craft Practice/Dyeing & Bleaching/Painting & Decoration) and any other subject. UTME subjects: accepts English Language, any one of Fine Arts/Literature-in-English/Music, one Arts subject and any Science or Social Science.
DE: accepts NCE with Fine/Creative Arts (Major).

DE: (a) three (3) GCE 'A' Level passes in Fine Arts or Technical Drawing plus the UTME requirements; (b) HND holders with an average of B grade with the UTME requirements into 300 level; (c) ND credit or NCE merit with the UTME requirements; (d) candidates would be interviewed. O'Level: requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes to include English Language, Fine and Applied Arts and one Science subject; candidates with NBC/NTC must have five (5) 'O' Level credit passes including English language, Technical drawing, Painting and Decorating and a Science subject.

DE: requires a pass in Literature in English at the 'A' Level GCE, or HSC or merit NCE, and in another Arts subject, Fine and Industrial Arts or Theatre Arts. O'Level: requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language and any four (4) of Literature in English, Fine Arts, History, Geography, Economics and Religious Studies at not more than two (2) sittings. UTME subjects: accepts any three (3) subjects.

DE: accepts A/level passes in GCE or HSC or IJMB or JUPEB in two (2) Art subjects including Literature in English, in addition to UTME entry requirements in two (2) Arts subjects including English Language, with an overall merit level Pass from a recognized College of Education. O'Level: requires Five (5) O Level Credits in English Language and any other four (4) subjects from Literature in English, History/Government, CRK/IRK, Economics, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Agricultural Science, Physics, Igbo/Hausa/Yoruba, Fine Art, Geography, Commerce. UTME subjects: requires any other three (3) subjects from the same list.

DE: in addition to the UTME requirements, candidates must have any of the following — OND in Fine Arts/Industrial Arts at Lower Credit level / HND / NCE: Fine Arts at Merit Level; IJMB minimum of 9 points. O'Level: requires Five (5) credit passes at SSCE, GCE, NECO and NABTEB O' Level including English Language, Mathematics and three other relevant subjects in not more than two sittings; credit level pass in Fine Arts/Visual Arts is an added advantage.

DE: (a) OND in Fine Art with a minimum grade of credit; (b) Diploma in Fine and Applied Arts, DELSU, with at least merit grade; (c) 'A' Level passes in Fine and Applied Arts and at least one other subject. O'Level: candidates without Fine Art/Visual Arts should possess at least five (5) 'O' Level credits which may include Mathematics, English Language and four other subjects from Arts, Social Science and Science. UTME subjects: requires any three (3) subjects from Arts and Social Science.

DE: applicants holding NCE with merit level and above from Ignatius Ajuru University of Education or any other recognized institution admitted for the BA.Ed programme in addition to completing the JAMB Direct Entry requirements; OR (a) Two (2) A Level passes in Arts or Fine Arts and any other subject; (b) ND upper credit / HND lower credit from recognised institutions. O'Level: requires SSCE or GCE O'level with five credit passes at not more than two sittings including English Language and Mathematics, other three from Arts or Social Sciences; candidates without a credit in Fine Art may be considered where need be; Grade II Teacher's Certificate, technical college graduates with NABTEB, NTC, City and Guilds with related craft certificates accepted with credit passes including English language and Fine Arts. UTME subjects: requires English Language and any three (3) from History, Government, Economics, Religious and Cultural Studies, Music, Fine Art, Commerce, Igbo, Literature in English, Social Studies, Accounting, or any other Arts or Social Sciences course.

O'Level: (a) 'O' Level credit pass in English Language provided Fine Art grade is not below B3; (b) 'O' Level credit passes in Mathematics and any three (3) subjects from Arts, Social Sciences and Sciences.
